doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Future dates with Chick Corea
summary: Laws says Chick Corea always initiates their collaborations and recently emailed about doing something soon.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Any more engagements coming up with Chick? Because that seems to be a . . .
It always comes and goes. So who knows? But he always initiates it. In fact he told me just recently. Last week I got an e-mail from him. He said we got to do something again soon, very soon.
But he’s always working. He’s working. I don’t know how that guy can stay on the road so much.
